about_me.title: A bit about me.
about_me.text_pt1: My interest in **development** started with **online games**, where I could spend the whole day playing and that would be the perfect day. But in 2010, without even realizing it at the time, I discovered one of my greatest passions: **customizing things**. Everything I had, I wanted to change from the **default** state.
about_me.text_pt2: That's when I created **a YouTube channel** about customizing Windows 7, where I could create, reuse, and have fun changing the entire operating system on my mom's laptop (she didn't even get mad, trust me).
about_me.text_pt3: And only in **2019** did I start my **development career** as a **full stack** developer, which I consider a great start. Having contact with a bit of everything was amazing, and learning something new every day was rewarding.
about_me.text_pt4: However, it was in **front end** where I truly found myself. Today, my focus is on creating **incredible** and **unique experiences** for users. Every project is an opportunity to **innovate** and **exceed** expectations, turning ideas into reality. The satisfaction of seeing users interacting with something I created is what motivates me to keep evolving and always striving for the best.

content.title: Superfood Project
content.overview_text: The **Superfood** project is a complete document management solution for the company Superfood, integrating frontend and backend with a Node.js API that connects to Google Drive. The system was developed to meet the company's specific needs, providing a user-friendly interface and a robust backend for efficient document and client management.

features.title: Authentication
features.text: Authentication in the system is performed using Google's **OAuth2.0** technology, ensuring security and ease of use.

features.title: Access Profiles
list: **Admin**: The admin profile has access to all system features, including document and client management.
**Regular User**: The regular user can view their assigned document requests and submit the required documents.

sections.subtitle: Admin Area
list: **Request CRUD**: The admin can create, view, update, and delete document requests.
**Document Rejection**: After a user submits a document, the admin can reject the document if there is any issue.
**Special Filters**: The admin has access to special filters that make it easier to manage users and documents.

sections.subtitle: User Area
list: **View Requests**: Users can view all document requests assigned to them.
**Submit Documents**: Users can submit documents in any format accepted by Google Drive. After submission, the document is automatically updated in the database and organized in Google Drive.

features.title: Storage Structure
features.text: Documents are automatically organized in Google Drive following the structure: **Department > Client > Year > Month > Day**, making maintenance and corrections easier for the Superfood team.

features.title: Client Management (Admin)
list: **Client CRUD**: The admin can manage all Superfood clients, including registering new clients, granting system access, deactivating, and reactivating clients.

content.final_considerations_text: The Superfood project was developed to simplify and optimize document and client management, using modern technologies and development best practices. With Google Drive integration, the system offers a complete and scalable solution for the company's needs.
